Test Title: Create a new pet with valid payload
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request to /pet with valid JSON payload.
2. Verify HTTP status code.
3. Verify response body fields match sent data.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response contains pet object with code 200, matching id, name, and status 'available'.

Test Title: Add pet missing required name field
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request to /pet without 'name' field.
2. Verify response status code.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server rejects with HTTP 400/405 validation error or accepts with default values (200 OK).

Test Title: Add pet with invalid enum status
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request to /pet with invalid status enum value.
2. Verify status code response.
Expected Response / Behavior: Server returns validation error 400/405 or handles graceful status assignment.

Test Title: Add pet with XSS payload in pet name
Test Steps:
1. Send POST request with HTML/JS script tag in 'name'.
2. Verify response handles script safely.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response retains sanitized text string without executing XSS payload.

Test Title: Update an existing pet via PUT
Pre-conditions: Pet with specified ID exists on server.
Test Steps:
1. Send PUT request to /pet with updated name and status 'sold'.
2. Verify response status code and updated fields.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response contains updated pet object with name 'doggie_updated' and status 'sold'.

Pre-conditions: Pets exist in database with various statuses.
Test Steps:
1. Send GET request to /pet/findByStatus?status=available.
2. Check HTTP status code.
3. Verify response is an array of pets.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body returns a JSON array of pets with status 'available'.

Pre-conditions: Pets exist in database with tags.
Test Steps:
1. Send GET request to /pet/findByTags?tags=tag1,tag2.
2. Check status code and array response.
Expected Response / Behavior: Response body returns a JSON array of pets matching requested tags.
